parameters.content:
## Northgate 7: Weekly Report
Every Monday at 8:00 (UK time) the recruiter gets one email: applications per role this week and in total, how they were banded, who is waiting for a decision (and for how long), interviews ahead and the average screening time. Built in code from the tables, so every number is exact.
